name: Washington DECA (high school)
org: Washington DECA, chartered association of DECA Inc.
what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter. You take a business or marketing class while in it. DECA supports local chapters. It runs a yearly state career development conference.
who_can_apply: Students in a business or marketing class taught by a CTE certified teacher at a school with a DECA chapter. The official page lists no age or grade rule.
pay_detail: Student membership is $20 total: $12 to the state association and $8 to DECA Inc. Chapters may add local costs.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines come from your chapter advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 25 to 27, 2027 at the Meydenbauer Center in Bellevue.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's DECA advisor, who registers members through DECA's online system. If your school has no chapter, DECA lists six steps to start one. State advisor: Lori Hairston, lori@wadeca.org.
notes: DECA's page lists 187 chapters in Washington. The state site is wadeca.org.
